name: e11-witness
comment: A: the watcher, and the source of B's damage -- E11 asks that B takes damage WHILE A
watches, so one client has to be both. Holds 12 m from the tank, which is outside
SeatArbiter.MaxSeatReachMetres (6) so this client can never accidentally take a seat,
and inside rifle range so the fire steps mean something.
It never toggles a seat, so its own activeCameras is the CONTROL for check 5: A16's fix
guards MountedTurret.Unholster with NetPresenterGate.IsLocalActor, and a remote human
mounting a turret must therefore leave this client's cameras alone.
Hitbox.ProjectileHit applies damage with no team test (P4 SS 4.1), so A and B being on
one team does not make the engagement fake.
